study type: Prospective cohort study with prediction model development
exposure: Exhaled breath volatile organic compounds (VOCs) at days 3 and 7 of life
outcome: Moderate or severe bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD) at 36 weeks postmenstrual age
cohort: The study included 117 infants born at <30 weeks' gestation (mean 26.8 ± 1.5 weeks).
finding: Adding exhaled VOC profiles to a clinical prediction model significantly improved its discriminative performance for moderate or severe BPD in preterm infants.
